slew_coverage.scope: Frozen library default applies to cell output drivers including tie, unused and propagated clock outputs. No set_max_transition or driving-cell rule for ideal top-level source ports; their waveform is fixed, upstream driver closure is not claimed.

structure.tie_method: Only two proven source-export hilomap ties may be replaced. Their exact 0/1 functions are substituted at every original pin and port; all original non-tie cells, including every FF and buffer, must remain with equivalent pins. Removed and replacement tie areas are both accounted.
